*delete before opening*

When updating a PR: please try to *rebase* feature branches on the main branch for a cleaner commit history ("update with rebase" on github).

Performance-related PRs will not be accepted without benchmarks of realistic usecases showing a performance improvement. See the benchmarks folder for examples.

Please avoid PRs updating versions for the sake of updating versions. They will already happen when minor and major versions of the containers increase and are usually feature/fix driven (or v.v. kept on an older version deliberately).
